description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations related to node entity display, field info, user predelete actions, node access control, and language deletion handling.

classes.name: NodeEntityHooks
classes.description: Drupal class implementing hook functions for node entities, including display alterations, field info, user predelete, access control, and language deletion.

methods.name: entityViewDisplayAlter
methods.description: Alters the entity view display to hide labels in search index view mode.

methods.name: entityExtraFieldInfo
methods.description: Provides extra field info for node bundles, adding a 'Links' display option.

methods.name: userPredelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup of nodes and revisions associated with a user before user deletion.

methods.name: nodeAccess
methods.description: Determines access rights for node operations like update and delete based on permissions and ownership.

methods.name: configurableLanguageDelete
methods.description: Removes language associations from nodes when a language is deleted.
